I couldn't reliably determine the answer, so I don't have a confirmed number and title for the most recently merged pull request in `firecrawl/cli`.

GitHub blocked every direct fetch with a 403: the PR list, the API and the commit history. Web search only returned sync pull requests from a fork, `ben-vargas/firecrawl-cli`. A bot (pull[bot]) opens those to mirror `firecrawl:main`, so their numbers aren't upstream PR numbers.

The search snippets did point to some upstream PRs. A fork sync dated Sep 26, 2026 included "Add top-level sql command and bump to 1.24.6 (#285)", which suggests upstream PR #285. A later sync, dated Sep 30, 2026, included a keyless-signup change and a bump to 1.25.0. I couldn't see that change's upstream number or title. Since today is Oct 16, 2026, there are probably newer merges that I couldn't see.

To get a definite answer, open https://github.com/firecrawl/cli/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged and sort by recently updated. If you run `gh pr list -R firecrawl/cli --state merged -L 1`, I can read the output.

Sources:

- [Pull Request #87 · ben-vargas/firecrawl-cli](https://github.com/ben-vargas/firecrawl-cli/pull/87)
